Explanation: Percentage of completed orders delivered within the promised delivery time. This is the main measure of delivery reliability.
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? Better delivery reliability and fewer customers experiencing delays. ? Indicates worsening delivery performance and requires root-cause investigation.

Explanation: Average time taken from order placement until the order is delivered to the customer.
Formula: ? (Actual Delivery Time ? Order Time) ÷ Completed Orders
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? Orders are taking longer to reach customers. ? Faster overall delivery, assuming service quality is maintained.

Explanation: Measures how many minutes late an order is when it misses the promised delivery time. Focuses on the severity of late deliveries.
Formula: ? (Actual Delivery Time ? Promised Delivery Time) for late orders ÷ Late Orders
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? Delays are becoming more severe. ? Late deliveries are becoming less severe.

Explanation: Measures time spent in key stages such as picking, packing, rider assignment/waiting and travel. Helps identify where delivery time is being lost.
Formula: Stage End Time ? Stage Start Time
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? More time is being consumed at that stage and it may represent a bottleneck. ? The stage is becoming more efficient.

Explanation: Measures how much each identified stage or delay cause contributes to the overall delay. Helps prioritize root causes.
Formula: Delay from specific cause ÷ Total delay × 100
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? That cause is becoming a larger contributor to delays and may deserve priority. ? Its contribution is reducing.

Explanation: Percentage of orders delayed during periods of high demand. Helps identify capacity and congestion problems.
Formula: Late orders during peak hours ÷ completed orders during peak hours × 100
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? Peak-hour capacity may be insufficient. ? Peak operations are handling demand more effectively.

Explanation: Percentage of orders delayed within a particular clubhouse/store or delivery zone. Used to identify operational hotspots.
Formula: Late orders in store/zone ÷ completed orders in store/zone × 100
If KPI Increases / Decreases: ? That location is experiencing poorer delivery reliability and needs investigation. ? Performance is improving.
